message.subject: Welcome to Shieldline: next step is your scan setup form
message.snippet: Hi John, thanks for booking your Lantern security assessment. Please complete the scan setup form so we can begin testing. The portal login link is included below for the results once the scan finishes.

answer.body:
Hi John,

Thanks for booking your Lantern security assessment with Shieldline. We've received your order and your account is now active.

Next step: please complete the scan setup form so our team can begin testing. It asks for the environment details we need to run the scan safely, including the hostnames or app URLs in scope and a technical contact for scan-day questions. Most clients finish it in about 15 minutes.

Scan setup form:
https://forms.shieldline.example/setup/lantern-2611

Once the scan finishes, the full findings, evidence fields and remediation notes will be available in the client portal. Sign in here:
https://portal.shieldline.example/login

If you have questions about scope or timing, reply to this email or call our client desk at (415) 555-0142, Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Pacific.

Thanks,
The Shieldline Onboarding Team
onboarding@shieldline.example
